The platform behind Webco websites

Websites, hosting, email, domains and support — managed in one place.

Webco Cloud is for businesses whose websites are built by Webco Media. Hosting, the domain, business email, renewals and support are looked after in one place.

Client loginGet support

What Webco Cloud looks after

  • Hosting

    The website stays online, with SSL, on hosting managed for you.

  • Domains

    The domain name is registered, connected and renewed with the website.

  • Email

    Professional email addresses on your own domain, set up with clear instructions.

  • Support

    A straightforward place to ask for help with the website, domain and email.

Who it is for

The first customers are small and medium UK businesses with a Webco Media website. A particular focus is HGV and transport training providers introduced through LearnHGV.

You do not need to manage servers, FTP, databases or DNS. Webco Cloud is the customer-facing home for the website service.

How the names fit together

  1. LearnHGV introduces relevant website services to HGV and transport training providers. Buying Webco services does not change LearnHGV ranking, verification or directory treatment. Those stay separate.

  2. Webco Media designs and builds the website.

  3. Webco Cloud runs hosting, domains, email, billing, renewals and support.

Webco Cloud

Webco Media builds the website. Webco Cloud runs the hosting, domain, email, billing and support.
